title: Michael's Article 15, discharge and coded record
summary: Michael Johnson tells of Michael's Article 15, discharge and coded record, about 1977-1978 at Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: when I left after my article 15, but honorable discharge, honorable discharge, they they said, "We give you honorable discharge."

plain: Michael Johnson, an Air Force veteran who says he was abducted along with a fellow airman, says that around 1977 and 1978 at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota he received an Article 15, a form of military punishment handed out without a court-martial. He says he was still given an honorable discharge, and the story concerns how his service record was marked afterward. He tells it as a sign the military handled him in an unusual way after the encounter.
